title: The wrong currency
story: ShopBot finds Asha's favourite hot sauce at Brooklyn Pantry, a US website, for USD 40. Asha's Mandate is in rupees. The Guard blocks it with CURRENCY_MISMATCH and skips the amount rules, because comparing dollars with rupee limits would be meaningless. No surprise foreign charge, and no way round the limits by switching currency.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Get me that smoky hot sauce I like.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Brooklyn Pantry in the US has it for USD 40. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

what_to_notice: In the inspector, per_txn_cap, monthly_cap and the other amount rules say not_evaluated rather than pass: the Guard never compares USD 40 with rupee limits. currency_match is the one rule that blocks.
